notes.title: Dev Chronicles #2 Meet the bosses!
notes.notes:
We are now designing some of the Bosses.
In old cartoons, bad guys have a familiar face.

Bringing freshness to combat mechanics is very difficult so to pass the bosses you will have to rely on cooperation with Spunky and find the most intelligent way to get rid of them.
Each one requires a specific strategy to beat them!

But it already starts with design!

notes.title: Dev Chronicles #1 Popping out!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027484/c3ca44ff1afe428fdb1a884a1aaecf31f4cf70a0.jpg[/img]

During the event [b]AG FRENCH DIRECT[/b], we have just announced the launch of [b]Paris Belle Epoque[/b] and able to share first screenshots and Gameplay walkthrough with you, our future players.
Note that we are at the very first stage of development, in PRE-ALPHA. So, yes, everything is far from being perfect, but we are working hard to polish and update our first vertical slice. 
We hope it will be finished in one month!

We'll be sharing updates of the development journey every week and can’t wait for you to test the demo and get feedback!

[b][i]Monochrome Team.
[/i][/b]
